title: One unit-source open-site stalk map lifts on one neighbourhood
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open neighbourhood of x, and S_U the ambient-ring-valued open module stalk functor [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor]. Let L be the unit module sheaf on the slice over U [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], N any module sheaf on that slice, and t:S_U(L) → S_U(N) a linear morphism. There exist x ∈ V ⊆ U, a natural isomorphism a:R_VU S_V ≅ S_U for slice restriction R [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and k:R_VU(L) → R_VU(N), with S_V(k)=a_L t a_N inverse in categorical composition order. Only the unit source is treated; no finite-rank parameter, simultaneous finite family, or further-restriction assertion occurs.

source.place: Modules Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, finite-generator portion of the finite-presentation proof; Sheaves Tag 00A0 (3). Read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00A0 on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Use the definition of the open stalk functor to write it as E followed by the subscheme module stalk and restriction of scalars. The open-immersion stalk ring map is an isomorphism; Mathlib restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv makes its restriction-of-scalars functor full. Take the unique preimage q of t. E sends the slice unit definitionally to the unit on U.toScheme; Mathlib and the existing locally-free library give its finite locally free instance.
Apply Modules.exists_restrict_stalk_hom_lift on U.toScheme to E(unit), E(N), and q. It supplies an actual local subscheme morphism f and the equation on every section germ.
Apply the pure supplied-morphism transport theorem to f and its germ equation. Package V, a and k and use Functor.map_preimage to replace the scalar restriction of q by t.

from.place: Refinement of the local finite-free-source stalk-map lifting step: existence on just one neighbourhood, without uniform coordinates or further restriction. Unit-source image-germ lifting, before intersecting finite coordinate neighbourhoods.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_stalk_unit_map_one_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (t : (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⟶
      (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).obj N) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
      let R := SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU)
      let S := openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      let F := SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)
      ∃ (a : R ⋙ S ≅ openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩)
        (k : R.obj F ⟶ R.obj N),
        S.map k = a.hom.app F ≫ t ≫ a.inv.app N
